ai_agent_sessions_principal_check.name: ai_agent_sessions_principal_check
ai_agent_sessions_principal_check.value: ("ai_agent_sessions"."principal_kind" = 'starter_user' AND "ai_agent_sessions"."owner_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ai_agent_sessions"."app_id" IS NULL) OR ("ai_agent_sessions"."principal_kind" = 'product_app' AND "ai_agent_sessions"."owner_id" IS NULL AND "ai_agent_sessions"."app_id" IS NOT NULL)

ai_agent_sessions_subject_pair_check.name: ai_agent_sessions_subject_pair_check
ai_agent_sessions_subject_pair_check.value: ("ai_agent_sessions"."subject_type" IS NULL AND "ai_agent_sessions"."subject_id" IS NULL) OR ("ai_agent_sessions"."subject_type" IS NOT NULL AND "ai_agent_sessions"."subject_id" IS NOT NULL)

ai_provider_payload_all_or_none.name: ai_provider_payload_all_or_none
ai_provider_payload_all_or_none.value: (payload_ciphertext IS NULL AND payload_iv IS NULL AND payload_auth_tag IS NULL AND encryption_version IS NULL) OR (payload_ciphertext IS NOT NULL AND payload_iv IS NOT NULL AND payload_auth_tag IS NOT NULL AND encryption_version IS NOT NULL)

ai_provider_credential_type.name: ai_provider_credential_type
ai_provider_credential_type.value: credential_type IS NULL OR credential_type IN ('api_key', 'oauth')

ai_settings_global_model_pair.name: ai_settings_global_model_pair
ai_settings_global_model_pair.value: (global_provider_id IS NULL AND global_model_id IS NULL) OR (global_provider_id IS NOT NULL AND global_model_id IS NOT NULL)

user_ai_preferences_model_pair.name: user_ai_preferences_model_pair
user_ai_preferences_model_pair.value: (provider_id IS NULL AND model_id IS NULL) OR (provider_id IS NOT NULL AND model_id IS NOT NULL)
